summary: Comprehensive test of Rate Mix (Fiyat Karışımı Analizi) feature — both backend and frontend. All 11 backend tests passed (analyze, single-property, 404, days clamp/window, auth, invalid rate, apply with room-type scaling, human-override protection, reprice bridge, applies history). Frontend palette flow, panel rendering (4 rows, 2 rec cards, days selector, stacked bars with £ per tier), days change reload, and apply-with-confirm-toast all working.
critical_code_review_comments: rate_mix.py analyze_property: tier boundary logic uses shadow name 'lo' inside the tuple loop that also shadows outer p05/p95 lo — works but confusing; consider renaming loop vars.

apply endpoint OVERWRITES robot-set overrides (market-robot etc.) by design (operator sovereignty); documented in agent note. Only human ('@' or space in set_by) and 'event-intelligence'/'owner-override' are protected — this is correct per spec.
Idempotent re-apply works because set_by='rate-mix' matches its own set_by pattern (no '@' or space, not in protected list) so it overwrites its own writes.
seed_data_creation: Applied rate 158/160 to aldgate-flats for days 14-20 (small window, safe range). Human override test created & cleaned up (day 15).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate Mix feature verified working end-to-end. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_rate_mix.py can be reused as regression. Aldgate-flats shows 91.5% floor share with £158 sweet-spot rec (+11.1%). Franziskaner shows 78.4% floor with £188 rec (+11.9%). UI palette query 'Fiyat Karışımı' loads panel data-testid='rate-mix-panel'. Apply button uses window.confirm and shows success toast in Turkish.
